newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks edge higher, big sale boosts volume.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks edge higher, big sale boosts volume.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange edged higher on Friday, but attention focused on a stock whose price did not move, Social Security Bank (SSB).
SSB shares ended unchanged at 1,350 cedis, but a huge 1,022,100 shares changed hands -- around 0.7 percent of the company's total capital, according to exchange records.
Dealers said the buyer of the stake was not revealed on the trading floor and would probably not be known until the middle of next week.
Ashanti Goldfields added 50 cedis to 22,050 while Unilever added five to 915.
Those were the only two gainers, but no prices fell, so the all-share index rose 0.31 point to 385.13.
